motivo: un género por obra: el más preciso, sin genéricos ni secciones
quien: Claude, recomendación (Juan: «sigue con género y sinopsis en inglés»)

valor: Olga lives a strictly regulated life without attachments in a vast apartment block. When out of financial necessity she rents a room in her apartment to a man who also sneaks-in his nine-year-old son, an unlikely bond forms. Her carefully controlled world begins to shift, and their lives become intertwined against her will.
